gloss.en: The root شكس (shaks) describes a person who is refractory, untractable, perverse, stubborn, or obstinate in disposition. It can also mean hard-hearted, ill-natured, or evil-dispositioned.
gloss.short: The root شكس (shaks) describes a person who is refractory, untractable, perverse, stubborn, or obstinate in disposition.
